import pytest
from datetime import datetime, time
from validate_punch import validate_punch, PunchInput, PunchResult

def test_valid_punch_at_office_within_time():
    # Office location: 12.9716, 77.5946
    # Timestamp within allowed window (08:00)
    ts = datetime.combine(datetime.today(), time(hour=8, minute=0))
    inp = PunchInput(employee_id="E123", timestamp=ts, latitude=12.9716, longitude=77.5946)
    result: PunchResult = validate_punch(inp)
    assert result.valid is True
    assert result.reason == ""

import pytest
from datetime import datetime, time
from validate_punch import validate_punch, PunchInput, PunchResult

def test_invalid_punch_outside_geofence():
    # Approx. 200 meters north of office (latitude increased by ~0.0018 degrees)
    ts = datetime.combine(datetime.today(), time(hour=9, minute=30))
    inp = PunchInput(employee_id="E124", timestamp=ts, latitude=12.9734, longitude=77.5946)
    result: PunchResult = validate_punch(inp)
    assert result.valid is False
    assert "distance" in result.reason.lower()

import pytest
from datetime import datetime, time
from validate_punch import validate_punch, PunchInput, PunchResult

def test_invalid_punch_outside_time_window():
    # Correct location but time 23:00 (outside 06:00‑22:00 window)
    ts = datetime.combine(datetime.today(), time(hour=23, minute=0))
    inp = PunchInput(employee_id="E125", timestamp=ts, latitude=12.9716, longitude=77.5946)
    result: PunchResult = validate_punch(inp)
    assert result.valid is False
    assert "time" in result.reason.lower()
